title: Keep autopublish from staging secrets, identity media, generated finals, logs, and caches
starting_state: The worktree contains a legitimate code change plus risky local files.
A closeout command would stage everything unless the safety gate blocks it or scopes includes.
done_when: Autopublish blocks risky paths and live-looking secrets.
Scoped includes still keep wiki-health closeout artifacts.
forbidden_changes: Do not stage mixed worktrees silently.
Do not auto-push from a hook.
fail_to_pass: seeded env, identity media, generated final, and synthetic live-looking token are blocked
pass_to_pass: placeholder secrets and scoped source includes remain allowed while preserving closeout artifacts
anti_gaming_notes: Hidden checker should include renamed media, nested __pycache__, and live-looking token strings.
